meta.name: InWonder
meta.description:
Shows about the worlds of science, technology and knowledge. Prepare to be taken on a factual adventure!

Shows: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker", Engineering Reborn S1 - "Maritime Museum, Coal Drops Yard, Peace Bunker", Engineering Reborn S1 - "St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre", Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Ceausescu's Delusions of Grandeur", War Factories S2 - "Apocalypse Factories"
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
